# M1 synthetic qualification history

Development model only. No real provider is qualified and no protocol state changes.

The verifier-owned pins in `qualification_model_pins_v1.py` select the current
`rev-002` corpus. The initial sibling JSON files are retained development revision
001; listing either directory is not selection or evidence of historical completeness.
There are three synthetic providers, each with two formations, two raw metadata
captures/reviews, six keyless model exchanges, two adverse service-change events,
and a fixed complete history head through 2030-03-01. Every applicable deadline
projects from that full head. Eleven distinct mandatory roles yield 33 admissions,
even when the roles share a timestamp. Formation, review, effective and detected
transition times are replayed separately as historical state traces.

The 15 frozen qualification review criterion names are all represented, with
actual model evidence/coverage/chronology checks. CRYPTOGRAPHIC is explicitly an
external authentication seam; packets, service/permission captures, pilot/standards
facts and independence identities are synthetic inputs. SHA-256 tree coverage,
wrong-nonce failure replay, schema omission regression, runtime identity,
repeatability, criteria coverage, exact bindings and historical state are executed.
This does not establish real cryptographic or operational qualification.

The model engine reuses the native strict member-byte/directory kernels and native
cutoff/succession/subset/completeness kernels via a typed family adapter. It uses
native result shape validation and exact admission on transient internal results.
It does not relax `execute_qualification_validation`: that real pipeline still
requires its frozen real schemas, signed public evidence and pinned verifiers.
No native public signature object, public key, fake binary or signing formula is
fabricated. Transient native-format VALID objects are enclosed by model admission
objects and are not persisted as public qualification authority. The public entry
rejects this synthetic contract. Full public claim integration remains a T09 gate.

The fixed model DVR proof deadline is 2030-02-19, with external cycle proof;
T04's native latest durability completion limit is 2030-02-20. They are separate
limits and both are preserved, with the model deadline checked against the limit.
